We're a non-profit foundation focused on macOS security, driven by the mission to create free tools, grow and support a global community of students, researchers, and defenders, and advance Apple security through education, research, collaboration, and opportunity, around the world.


What We Do

We support the Apple security ecosystem through a combination of free tools, education, community initiatives, and global collaboration.

Free Open-Source Security Tools

We create and maintain free, open-source macOS security tools trusted by researchers, enterprises, and everyday users around the world.

Explore our tools →

Blog

In-depth writing on macOS security, malware analysis, and real-world threats. Written to educate and share knowledge openly.

Read the blog →

Objective by the Sea (#OBTS)

The world’s only conference dedicated exclusively to Apple security, bringing together top researchers and the global community.

Learn about #OBTS →

Objective-We

Making Apple security more accessible through trainings, scholarships, mentorship, and community support.

Discover Objective-We →

Objective For The We (#OFTW)

Free trainings and entry-level talks introducing students and early-career professionals to Apple security, with practical skills, career guidance, and networking opportunities.

View #OFTW →

Objective-Steve

A career-support initiative connecting community talent with real opportunities in Apple security.

Learn about Objective-Steve →

The Art of Mac Malware (Book Series)

A respected educational resource on macOS security and malware analysis. Digital editions are free, and all royalties from printed copies are donated to the Foundation.

Explore the books →

Malware Collection

We publish technical research and curate malware samples to support learning, analysis, and responsible Apple security research.

View our collection →
